summary.en: Singapore's first reservoir, completed in 1867; named after the engineer James MacRitchie in 1922.
summary.zh: 新加坡第一个蓄水池，1867 年建成；1922 年以工程师麦里芝命名。

summary.en: The second reservoir, first called Kallang River Reservoir; renamed Peirce in 1922 and Lower Peirce in 1975.
summary.zh: 第二个蓄水池，原名加冷河蓄水池；1922 年改名贝雅士，1975 年改名贝雅士蓄水池下段。

summary.en: The third reservoir, Seletar, from 1920; enlarged in 1940 and 1967; renamed Upper Seletar in 1992.
summary.zh: 第三个蓄水池实里达，1920 年起；1940 年和 1967 年两次扩建；1992 年改名实里达蓄水池上段。

summary.en: A higher dam upstream of Peirce Reservoir, completed in 1975.
summary.zh: 在贝雅士蓄水池上游筑起更高的坝，1975 年建成。

summary.en: Formed when the upper Jurong River was dammed in 1971.
summary.zh: 1971 年在裕廊河上游筑坝形成。

summary.en: A river mouth dammed under the Kranji–Pandan Water Scheme, completed in 1975.
summary.zh: 按克兰芝—班丹水源计划在河口筑坝，1975 年完成。

summary.en: The swamps of the Pandan river mouth enclosed with an earthen dyke in 1974.
summary.zh: 1974 年用土堤围住班丹河口的沼泽而成。

summary.en: One of the western rivers dammed between 1975 and 1981.
summary.zh: 1975 年至 1981 年间筑坝的西部河流之一。

summary.en: One of the western rivers dammed between 1975 and 1981.
summary.zh: 1975 年至 1981 年间筑坝的西部河流之一。

summary.en: One of the western rivers dammed between 1975 and 1981.
summary.zh: 1975 年至 1981 年间筑坝的西部河流之一。

summary.en: One of the western rivers dammed between 1975 and 1981.
summary.zh: 1975 年至 1981 年间筑坝的西部河流之一。

summary.en: The mouth of the Seletar River dammed in 1986 (Sungei Seletar–Bedok Water Scheme).
summary.zh: 1986 年在实里达河口筑坝而成（实里达河—勿洛水源计划）。

summary.en: A former sand quarry turned into a reservoir, completed in 1986.
summary.zh: 由采沙场改建的蓄水池，1986 年建成。

summary.en: The reservoir on the island of Pulau Tekong, one of the 17.
summary.zh: 德光岛上的蓄水池，17 个之一。

summary.en: The 15th reservoir and the first in the city centre, behind Marina Barrage (2008); fresh water from 2010.
summary.zh: 第 15 个蓄水池，也是第一个位于市中心的蓄水池，在滨海堤坝之内（2008 年）；2010 年起成为淡水蓄水池。

summary.en: An estuary reservoir commissioned in 2011.
summary.zh: 2011 年启用的河口蓄水池。

summary.en: An estuary reservoir commissioned in 2011, bringing the number of reservoirs to 17.
summary.zh: 2011 年启用的河口蓄水池，蓄水池总数由此达到 17 个。

summary.en: Britain's naval base at Sembawang, begun in 1928, is officially opened with the King George VI Dock; it is called the 'Gibraltar of the East'.
summary.zh: 英国在三巴旺修建的海军基地 1928 年动工，与乔治六世船坞一同正式启用，被称为“东方直布罗陀”。

detail.en: The base was built to receive a British fleet sent from Europe in an emergency; no large fleet was stationed there. Planning assumed the fleet could arrive within 70 days of war breaking out; in September 1939, with war in Europe, the Chiefs of Staff extended this 'period before relief' to 180 days.
detail.zh: 基地是为了在紧急时接纳从欧洲派来的英国舰队而修的，平时并没有大舰队驻扎。计划假定开战后 70 天内舰队可以赶到；1939 年 9 月欧洲开战后，参谋长委员会把这一“待援期”延长到 180 天。

summary.en: The airport officially opened on 20 August 1955.
summary.zh: 【待译】The airport officially opened on 20 August 1955.

summary.en: Operations began in 1928; the official opening was on 1 January 1930.
summary.zh: 【待译】Operations began in 1928; the official opening was on 1 January 1930.

summary.en: RAF Tengah was built in 1939.
summary.zh: 【待译】RAF Tengah was built in 1939.

summary.en: The British government map marks the airfield here; this date identifies the map, not the opening.
summary.zh: 【待译】The British government map marks the airfield here; this date identifies the map, not the opening.

title.en: The Housing and Development Board is formed
title.zh: 【待译】The Housing and Development Board is formed

summary.en: HDB replaces the Singapore Improvement Trust to expand public housing.
summary.zh: 【待译】HDB replaces the Singapore Improvement Trust to expand public housing.

detail.en: The marker represents the city area, not a verified founding-day office address.
detail.zh: 【待译】The marker represents the city area, not a verified founding-day office address.

summary.en: About 16,000 people lost their homes and four people died. The cause remains unknown.
summary.zh: 【待译】About 16,000 people lost their homes and four people died. The cause remains unknown.

summary.en: Remaining affected families had been rehoused by February 1962. Building continued on the fire site and surrounding land.
summary.zh: 【待译】Remaining affected families had been rehoused by February 1962. Building continued on the fire site and surrounding land.

detail.en: NLB records 12,562 flats built by 1967 on the fire site and adjacent land. This is not a count of buildings standing today.
detail.zh: 【待译】NLB records 12,562 flats built by 1967 on the fire site and adjacent land. This is not a count of buildings standing today.

summary.en: Blocks at Stirling Road completed in October 1960 were handed to residents in 1961.
summary.zh: 【待译】Blocks at Stirling Road completed in October 1960 were handed to residents in 1961.

detail.en: NHB identifies Blocks 45, 48 and 49. The point represents Stirling Road; this completion milestone is distinct from SIT planning Queenstown in 1953.
detail.zh: 【待译】NHB identifies Blocks 45, 48 and 49. The point represents Stirling Road; this completion milestone is distinct from SIT planning Queenstown in 1953.

summary.en: HDB launches a scheme to sell flats to lower-income families.
summary.zh: 【待译】HDB launches a scheme to sell flats to lower-income families.

detail.en: The point represents housing policy in the city, not a documented ceremony location.
detail.zh: 【待译】The point represents housing policy in the city, not a documented ceremony location.

summary.en: Around 12,000 people lost their homes in the fire.
summary.zh: 【待译】Around 12,000 people lost their homes in the fire.

title.en: Parliament approves the land acquisition law
title.zh: 【待译】Parliament approves the land acquisition law

summary.en: The Bill was passed in 1966; the Act took effect on 17 June 1967. It allowed compulsory acquisition with compensation.
summary.zh: 【待译】The Bill was passed in 1966; the Act took effect on 17 June 1967. It allowed compulsory acquisition with compensation.

detail.en: The point represents Parliament and the city. Compensation rules changed over time. CLC records the public-development rationale and owners’ difficulties replacing property bought out at historical valuations.
detail.zh: 【待译】The point represents Parliament and the city. Compensation rules changed over time. CLC records the public-development rationale and owners’ difficulties replacing property bought out at historical valuations.

summary.en: HDB began preparing land for its first comprehensively planned new town.
summary.zh: 【待译】HDB began preparing land for its first comprehensively planned new town.

summary.en: JTC dates the conception of the industrial estate to 1961. This is not a single opening date for every factory.
summary.zh: 【待译】JTC dates the conception of the industrial estate to 1961. This is not a single opening date for every factory.

summary.en: A corporation was established to develop and manage industrial estates.
summary.zh: 【待译】A corporation was established to develop and manage industrial estates.

detail.en: JTC’s timeline gives 1968. The exact Act commencement day remains an indexed-only check, so the event keeps year precision.
detail.zh: 【待译】JTC’s timeline gives 1968. The exact Act commencement day remains an indexed-only check, so the event keeps year precision.

title.en: Ang Mo Kio’s first slab blocks
title.zh: 【待译】Ang Mo Kio’s first slab blocks

summary.en: The first slab blocks were built in Neighbourhoods 2 and 3.
summary.zh: 【待译】The first slab blocks were built in Neighbourhoods 2 and 3.

summary.en: Building of Tampines New Town begins in the east.
summary.zh: 【待译】Building of Tampines New Town begins in the east.

summary.en: NHB shows the first Marsiling blocks under construction in 1972. This is an early-building milestone, not completion of the whole town.
summary.zh: 【待译】NHB shows the first Marsiling blocks under construction in 1972. This is an early-building milestone, not completion of the whole town.

title.en: Farms give way to other uses
title.zh: 【待译】Farms give way to other uses

summary.en: CLC reports roughly 8,000 farms phased out between 1975 and 1984, as land and water policies changed.
summary.zh: 【待译】CLC reports roughly 8,000 farms phased out between 1975 and 1984, as land and water policies changed.

title.en: A decision to phase out pig farming
title.zh: 【待译】A decision to phase out pig farming

summary.en: The government announces an island-wide phase-out. CLC dates the end of the last pig farms to 1989.
summary.zh: 【待译】The government announces an island-wide phase-out. CLC dates the end of the last pig farms to 1989.

detail.en: Government sources cite land, water and treatment costs. CLC also records farmers’ criticism after investment in Punggol and the disruption of family businesses.
detail.zh: 【待译】Government sources cite land, water and treatment costs. CLC also records farmers’ criticism after investment in Punggol and the disruption of family businesses.

summary.en: Land is reserved for farms using technology; first tenders for Sungei Tengah, Murai and Loyang were scheduled for September 1986.
summary.zh: 【待译】Land is reserved for farms using technology; first tenders for Sungei Tengah, Murai and Loyang were scheduled for September 1986.

summary.en: SFA dates Singapore’s first indoor farm to 2014; the operator reported the facility was established in October 2013 and began pilot commercial supply in July 2014.
summary.zh: 【待译】SFA dates Singapore’s first indoor farm to 2014; the operator reported the facility was established in October 2013 and began pilot commercial supply in July 2014.

detail.en: The marker represents western Singapore only; the exact facility location was not verified. The two dates describe establishment and commercial supply respectively.
detail.zh: 【待译】The marker represents western Singapore only; the exact facility location was not verified. The two dates describe establishment and commercial supply respectively.

summary.en: The revised strategy targets local capacity for selected fibre and protein foods by 2035. These are future capacity goals, not all-food self-sufficiency.
summary.zh: 【待译】The revised strategy targets local capacity for selected fibre and protein foods by 2035. These are future capacity goals, not all-food self-sufficiency.

detail.en: An island-wide policy marker. Fibre means fresh leafy and fruited vegetables, beansprouts and mushrooms; protein here means eggs and seafood.
detail.zh: 【待译】An island-wide policy marker. Fibre means fresh leafy and fruited vegetables, beansprouts and mushrooms; protein here means eggs and seafood.

summary.en: A surviving mainland kampong, used here as a place to discuss village life rather than a model of all earlier villages.
summary.zh: 【待译】A surviving mainland kampong, used here as a place to discuss village life rather than a model of all earlier villages.

detail.en: The date is the map timeline start, not the village’s founding date. Point is a representative location in the village.
detail.zh: 【待译】The date is the map timeline start, not the village’s founding date. Point is a representative location in the village.

summary.en: Non-exempt vehicles entering the restricted city zone during charging hours needed a paid supplementary licence.
summary.zh: 【待译】Non-exempt vehicles entering the restricted city zone during charging hours needed a paid supplementary licence.

summary.en: Commercial operations begin at the eastern tip, on a site enlarged through reclamation.
summary.zh: 【待译】Commercial operations begin at the eastern tip, on a site enlarged through reclamation.

summary.en: The ceremony followed the first passenger services, which had begun in November 1987.
summary.zh: 【待译】The ceremony followed the first passenger services, which had begun in November 1987.

title.en: Vehicle ownership is controlled by quota
title.zh: 【待译】Vehicle ownership is controlled by quota

summary.en: The vehicle quota system requires a Certificate of Entitlement for new vehicle registrations.
summary.zh: 【待译】The vehicle quota system requires a Certificate of Entitlement for new vehicle registrations.

detail.en: NHB’s National Museum collection record dates implementation to May 1990. The marker represents an island-wide policy, not a specific ceremony location.
detail.zh: 【待译】NHB’s National Museum collection record dates implementation to May 1990. The marker represents an island-wide policy, not a specific ceremony location.

summary.en: Electronic charging begins on expressways, with city-zone charging following later in 1998.
summary.zh: 【待译】Electronic charging begins on expressways, with city-zone charging following later in 1998.

summary.en: A sequence of reclamation projects moves the south-eastern shore seawards over the following decades.
summary.zh: 【待译】A sequence of reclamation projects moves the south-eastern shore seawards over the following decades.

detail.en: The programme had several phases over about thirty years; 1985 is not a verified overall endpoint.
detail.zh: 【待译】The programme had several phases over about thirty years; 1985 is not a verified overall endpoint.

summary.en: Marina Centre works began in 1974; Marina East and South followed from 1979, with further bay-edge works in the early 1990s.
summary.zh: 【待译】Marina Centre works began in 1974; Marina East and South followed from 1979, with further bay-edge works in the early 1990s.

summary.en: Reclamation joins seven islands to create land for the oil and chemical industries.
summary.zh: 【待译】Reclamation joins seven islands to create land for the oil and chemical industries.

detail.en: Opening is different from completion of every reclamation phase; NLB and JTC give later completion dates for differently scoped works.
detail.zh: 【待译】Opening is different from completion of every reclamation phase; NLB and JTC give later completion dates for differently scoped works.

summary.en: Liquid hydrocarbons can be stored in rock caverns below the island, freeing land at the surface.
summary.zh: 【待译】Liquid hydrocarbons can be stored in rock caverns below the island, freeing land at the surface.

summary.en: A key handover ceremony marks a housing development with 50-storey blocks.
summary.zh: 【待译】A key handover ceremony marks a housing development with 50-storey blocks.

summary.en: NLB describes expansion during the 1970s and an extension in the late 1980s.
summary.zh: 【待译】NLB describes expansion during the 1970s and an extension in the late 1980s.

detail.en: NLB dates a sequence of Jurong and Tuas reclamations to the 1970s, without a single start day. This decade marker is placed at 1970, the decade’s beginning; it does not claim a construction start in that year.
detail.zh: 【待译】NLB dates a sequence of Jurong and Tuas reclamations to the 1970s, without a single start day. This decade marker is placed at 1970, the decade’s beginning; it does not claim a construction start in that year.

summary.en: The map shows the planned use of land under the statutory Master Plan, not a survey of what occupied every plot.
summary.zh: 【待译】The map shows the planned use of land under the statutory Master Plan, not a survey of what occupied every plot.

summary.en: Opened as a nature park in 1993; gazetted as a nature reserve in 2002.
summary.zh: 【待译】Opened as a nature park in 1993; gazetted as a nature reserve in 2002.

summary.en: Labrador was gazetted as a nature reserve in January 2002, protecting a coastal forest habitat.
summary.zh: 【待译】Labrador was gazetted as a nature reserve in January 2002, protecting a coastal forest habitat.

detail.en: Ng Lang’s 2008 article, written as NParks chief executive, confirms the gazette month. The map uses today’s boundary approximately, not the historical gazetted outline.

summary.en: A reservoir on the upper Johor River in Johor, completed in 1993, that keeps enough water in the river for the intake downstream.
summary.zh: 柔佛河上游的水库，1993 年建成，让下游取水点的河水保持充足。

summary.en: Owned by Johor; built, paid for and operated by PUB under the 1990 agreement.
summary.zh: 属于柔佛；按 1990 年协议由 PUB 兴建、出资和运作。
